title: IdentityUseraddResult
description: The created account's sign-in identity. A generated password is present only in this one answer and is not stored by the launcher.

identity.description: The identity the account acts under in Semiont.

created.description: Whether a new account was created.

generatedPassword.description: The generated password, returned once so the operator can share it with the user. Absent when the operator supplied the password.
